channel.title: Official EVO Magazine - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Official EVO Magazine (evo.co.uk)

item.title: New Mercedes-AMG GLC 53 turns back on downsizing with 443bhp straight-six
item.description: The new GLC 53 begins AMG’s move away from four-cylinder engines in certain models, packing a 3-litre turbocharged inline six

item.title: The Ferrari Luce has an interior designed by Apple’s Jony Ive – we take a look
item.description: We’ve seen the powertrain, now we head to San Francisco to get hands on with the bold new interior for Ferrari’s very first EV: the Luce

item.title: evo magazine issue 343 March 2026 – on sale now
item.description: It’s a French revolution in the new issue of evo, with iconic 80’s hot hatches and jewel-like Alpine A110 coach builds, plus a whole lot more

item.title: Caterham Seven 2026 updates – lightweight legend lives on with petrol power
item.description: Caterham’s updated the options list for its Seven sports and track cars for 2026

item.title: 2027 Range Rover spied – Land Rover’s luxury icon sharpens up
item.description: The fifth-generation Range Rover is due a mid-life facelift soon. We’ve spied it

item.title: Autoforma Norrsken is the classic Volvo restomod you never knew you needed
item.description: Another day, another restomod, this one an early 1970s Volvo with a five-cylinder turbo engine

item.title: Porsche 911 Carrera Cabriolet reimagined by Singer – without the help of Red Bull?
item.description: Singer’s lopping the top off its reimagined 911 Carrera Coupe for a 75-car run

item.title: Used car deals of the week: a Ferrari F12 for supersaloon money
item.description: We dive into the classifieds this week to find the very best performance cars for the least amount of money, including a cut-price V12 Ferrari

item.title: New BMW M5 2027 facelift spied – the hybrid Audi RS6 won’t have it easy
item.description: The LCI update for the BMW M5 will being Neue Klasse stylistic sensibility to BMW’s big garish super saloon

item.title: New Polestar 2: Swedish Tesla rival to finally be replaced in 2027
item.description: The saloon model will be one of two new models alongside a new Polestar 4 variant being introduced over the next two years
